name: Using QuTiP, implement a function that verifies the complete positivity of a qua
task_prompt: Using QuTiP, implement a function that verifies the complete positivity of a quantum map given as a Choi matrix. The function should take a `qutip.Qobj` representing the Choi operator and return a boolean indicating whether it is a valid Choi matrix (i.e., Hermitian, trace-preserving, and completely positive). Also write a simple test case: construct the Choi matrix of the identity channel on one qubit and confirm your function returns True.
